g.text: LLM backends, host-env daemons, Shared MCP hosts, and the raw whisper-agent.toml editor. Mutation
paths are admin-only — non-admin connections see an error reply that surfaces in the per-tab banner.
Shared MCP hosts the scheduler connects to at startup (one singleton session per name, shared across
all threads that opt in). Bearer tokens never come back from the server — the UI shows only auth kind.
Configure how the scheduler connects to a third-party MCP host. Bearer
tokens are stored server-side and are never echoed back to the client.
Tools will appear to the model as `<host name>_<tool>`.
